title: Planner: Planner Plugin lets Copilot Cowork read and update plans and tasks
summary: The briefing's rollout, licensing, approval requirements and documented controls are supported. Minor corrections would complete the navigation paths, cite the billing overview and reconcile the governance checklist with the controls table.

claims.claim: Planner Plugin availability is managed in Microsoft 365 admin center under Agents > Tools > Planner Plugin > Users.
claims.quote: To block the plugin, go to Agents > Tools, select Planner Plugin, open the Users tab, and select Block.
claims.fix: The path reaches the correct tab but stops before its controls. Extend it to 'Agents > Tools > Planner Plugin > Users > Available to specific users or groups'; retain the alternative availability and Block options in the note, and the separate installation route in the prose.
